description:
Free diagnostic tools for AI agents and MCP servers. No API key needed.

  The only MCP linter that exists. Validate your tool definitions for anti-patterns, missing descriptions, and schema
  issues. Plus governance scoring (0-100), cost estimation across all major models, and trust evaluation for any MCP
  server.

  Free Tools:
  - mcp_manifest_lint -- Validate MCP tool definitions. Pass/fail report with fixes.
  - agent_health_check -- Score your agent's system prompt on 17 governance best practices.
  - estimate_agent_cost -- Compare costs across Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and 20+ models.
  - evaluate_service -- Check any MCP server's trustworthiness before spending money.

  Expert Skills (10 free calls/day):
  Curated context packages for governance, agentic economics, and intent architecture. Register for a free API key to
  start.

  Connect: https://api.asalvocreative.com/mcp

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register for an API key to access expert skill files. Free tier includes 10 skill retrievals per day. No payment required.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List all available expert skill files with descriptions and pricing. Shows your usage stats if you provide an API key.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Your API key (optional, shows usage if provided)

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Retrieve an expert skill file that makes you measurably better at a specific task. Each skill has auditable provenance and is curated by domain experts. Requires a valid API key.

skill_name.title: Skill Name
skill_name.description: The skill ID to retrieve. Options: governance, agentic-economics, intent-architecture

tools.name: check_usage
tools.description: Check your current usage stats including total calls, remaining credits, and free calls left today.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Your API key to check usage for

tools.name: buy_credits
tools.description: Get a Stripe checkout link to purchase more skill file credits. Returns a URL for your human operator to complete payment. Credits are added automatically after purchase.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Credit tier: '50' for $5/50 credits or '250' for $20/250 credits

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Your API key to add credits to

tools.name: agent_health_check
tools.description: Score any agent's system prompt on governance best practices from 0 to 100. Returns a detailed diagnostic report with specific issues found, severity ratings, and actionable fixes. Checks for authority leaks, silent inference, missing audit trails, and 14 other governance anti-patterns. No API key needed.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Your agent's full system prompt or configuration text to analyze

tools.name: mcp_manifest_lint
tools.description: The only MCP tool definition linter that exists. Validates your MCP tool definitions for anti-patterns, missing descriptions, bad parameter schemas, naming issues, and quality problems. Returns a pass/fail report with specific fixes for each issue found. No API key needed.

tools_json.title: Tools Json
tools_json.description: Your MCP tool definitions as a JSON array or single tool object

tools.name: estimate_agent_cost
tools.description: Compare the cost of running an agent task across all major AI models including Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral. Returns a comparison table with per-call, per-run, and per-day costs plus optimization tips. No API key needed.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name to highlight in comparison (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4', 'gpt-4o')

num_calls.title: Num Calls
num_calls.description: Number of API calls per task run

input_tokens.title: Input Tokens
input_tokens.description: Estimated input tokens per API call

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: Estimated output tokens per API call

task_description.title: Task Description
task_description.description: Description of what the agent does, for optimization tips

tools.name: evaluate_service
tools.description: Evaluate any MCP service for trustworthiness before spending money on it. Connects to the target server, checks reachability, governance declarations, tool definition quality, and audit endpoints. Returns a trust score from 0 to 100 with a recommendation: PROCEED, PROCEED WITH CAUTION, HIGH RISK, or DO NOT TRANSACT. No API key needed.

server_url.title: Server Url
server_url.description: The MCP server URL to evaluate (e.g. https://example.com/mcp)

task_context.title: Task Context
task_context.description: What you need the service for, to tailor the evaluation

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.description: Get started with the Agentic Platform. Shows available tools and how to use them.
